messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment order can only be charged to an account of type CTE (current), AHO (savings) or VIR (virtual). Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "@i_tipo_cuenta not in ('CTE','AHO','VIR')",
  "action": "Set error 50001 and message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO', then go to the error exit. Nothing is debited.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Savings account accepted\n Given account type 'AHO'\n When the payment is requested\n Then the account type check passes and processing continues",
   "Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected\n Given account type 'PLZ'\n When the payment is requested\n Then the result is error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Order must exist and be pending",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The payment order, identified by order number and company, must exist and be in state 'P' (pending). If it is missing the error is 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'; if it is in any other state the error is 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "condition": "No row in pg_orden for ord_numero=@i_orden and ord_empresa=@i_empresa -> 50002; row found and ord_estado <> 'P' -> 50003",
  "action": "Reject the payment with the matching error code and message; otherwise continue.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Pending order\n Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'P'\n When the payment is requested\n Then processing continues",
   "Scenario: Order not found\n Given no order 9999 for company 7\n When the payment is requested\n Then error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
   "Scenario: Order already paid\n Given order 1001 of company 7 in state 'A'\n When the payment is requested\n Then error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'",
   "Scenario: Order belongs to another company\n Given order 1001 exists only for company 8\n When company 7 requests the payment\n Then error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Tariff lookup: company tariff first, else general service tariff",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "The commission tariff is the one agreed for the company and service. If the company has none, the general service tariff applies and the commission is never charged separately. A missing tariff counts as 0.",
  "condition": "Row in ad_tarifa_empresa for (@i_empresa,@i_servicio) -> tarifa=tar_valor, separada=tar_separada; otherwise tarifa=srv_tarifa from ad_servicio and separada='N'; tarifa null -> 0",
  "action": "Set @w_tarifa and @w_separada accordingly.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Company tariff exists\n Given company 7 has tariff 5.00 for service 'PROV' with separate charge 'S'\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 5.00 and separate charge is 'S'",
   "Scenario: Fallback to the service table\n Given company 7 has no tariff for 'PROV' and the service tariff is 4.00\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 4.00 and separate charge is 'N'",
   "Scenario: No tariff anywhere\n Given neither table has a tariff\n When the tariff is resolved\n Then tariff is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Commission: web channel pays half, payroll pays none",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P1",
  "statement": "Orders from the WEB channel pay half of the tariff, rounded to 2 decimals. Every other channel pays the full tariff. The service 'NOMINA' (payroll) never pays commission.",
  "condition": "@i_canal='WEB' -> comision=round(tarifa/2,2); else comision=tarifa; if @i_servicio='NOMINA' -> comision=0",
  "action": "Compute @w_comision.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Web channel\n Given tariff 5.25, channel 'WEB', service 'PROV'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 2.63",
   "Scenario: Other channel\n Given tariff 5.25, channel 'OFI', service 'PROV'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 5.25",
   "Scenario: Payroll\n Given tariff 5.00, channel 'OFI', service 'NOMINA'\n When the commission is calculated\n Then commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Total to debit includes commission unless charged separately",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The amount debited on the first movement is the order value plus the commission, unless the commission is charged separately (flag 'S'), in which case only the order value is debited.",
  "condition": "@w_separada='S' -> total=@i_valor; else total=@i_valor+@w_comision",
  "action": "Set @w_total.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included\n Given value 1000.00, commission 2.50, separate flag 'N'\n When the total is calculated\n Then total is 1002.50",
   "Scenario: Commission separate\n Given value 1000.00, commission 2.50, separate flag 'S'\n Then total is 1000.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Sufficient funds check with overdraft allowance",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Virtual accounts (VIR) cannot go below zero: the balance must cover the total to debit. Other accounts may overdraw up to 100.00. Otherwise the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'.",
  "condition": "(tipo='VIR' and saldo < total) or (tipo<>'VIR' and saldo + 100.00 < total)",
  "action": "Set error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' and go to the error exit; otherwise continue.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Virtual account exact balance\n Given VIR account with balance 500.00 and total 500.00\n Then the payment passes the check",
   "Scenario: Virtual account short\n Given VIR account with balance 499.99 and total 500.00\n Then error 50004",
   "Scenario: Current account within overdraft\n Given CTE account with balance 0.00 and total 100.00\n Then the payment passes (balance + 100.00 is not less than total)",
   "Scenario: Current account beyond overdraft\n Given CTE account with balance 0.00 and total 100.01\n Then error 50004",
   "Scenario: Account not found\n Given no account row matches number and type\n Then the balance is null and neither comparison is true, so the check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Debit of the account and separate commission movement, all or nothing",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Inside one transaction the account is debited for the total with reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and its movement number is returned. If the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, a second debit with reference 'COMISION PAGO' is made. A failure in either debit undoes the transaction and rejects the payment (50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO' or 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION').",
  "condition": "sp_debito returns <>0 or @@error<>0 -> 50005; separada='S' and comision>0 and second sp_debito returns <>0 -> 50006",
  "action": "Call sp_debito for @w_total; if separada='S' and comision>0, call it again for @w_comision; on any failure roll back and go to the error exit.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included\n Given total 1002.50 and separate flag 'N'\n Then one debit of 1002.50 'PAGO ORDEN' is made and no commission movement",
   "Scenario: Commission separate\n Given value 1000.00, commission 2.50, flag 'S'\n Then a debit of 1000.00 'PAGO ORDEN' and a debit of 2.50 'COMISION PAGO' are made",
   "Scenario: Separate flag but zero commission (payroll)\n Given flag 'S' and commission 0\n Then no second movement is made",
   "Scenario: Commission debit fails\n Given the second debit returns non-zero\n Then the transaction is rolled back, including the first debit, and error 50006 is returned",
   "Scenario: First debit fails\n Given sp_debito returns non-zero\n Then rollback and error 50005"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Order marked as paid with processing date and commission",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "After the debits, the order changes from pending to paid ('A'), recording the processing date as payment date and the commission charged. If the update fails or touches no row, everything is rolled back with error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'. On success the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "condition": "update of pg_orden for (@i_orden,@i_empresa) has error<>0 or rowcount=0 -> rollback, 50007; else commit",
  "action": "Set ord_estado='A', ord_fecha_pago=@i_fecha_proceso, ord_comision=@w_comision; commit; message 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful payment\n Given a pending order and successful debits, processing date 2024-05-31\n Then the order is 'A', payment date 2024-05-31, commission recorded and message 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
   "Scenario: Update touches no row\n Given the order row cannot be updated\n Then the transaction, including the debits, is rolled back and error 50007 is returned"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories": [
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Validate the account type and the pending order before paying",
"narrative": "As a company treasury operator, I want the payment to be accepted only for a debitable account and an existing pending order, so that money is never taken from the wrong account or for an order that cannot be paid.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario Outline: Account types that can be debited
  Given a payment order charged to an account of type <account_type>
  When the payment is requested
  Then the account type check passes and processing continues

  Examples:
    | account_type |
    | CTE |
    | AHO |
    | VIR |",
"Scenario: Unsupported account type rejected
  Given a payment order charged to an account of type 'PLZ'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the result is error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'
  And nothing is debited",
"Scenario: Pending order accepted
  Given order 1001 of company 7 is in state 'P'
  When the payment is requested
  Then processing continues",
"Scenario: Order not found
  Given there is no order 9999 for company 7
  When the payment is requested
  Then the result is error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
"Scenario: Order belongs to another company
  Given order 1001 exists only for company 8
  When company 7 requests the payment of order 1001
  Then the result is error 50002 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
"Scenario: Order already paid
  Given order 1001 of company 7 is in state 'A'
  When the payment is requested
  Then the result is error 50003 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
],
"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Calculate the commission and the total to debit",
"narrative": "As a company treasury operator, I want the commission to be determined from the agreed tariff and the channel, and added to the debit unless it is charged separately, so that the amount taken from the account is correct.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Company tariff takes precedence
  Given company 7 has tariff 5.00 for service 'PROV' with separate charge 'S'
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 5.00
  And the separate charge flag is 'S'",
"Scenario: Fallback to the general service tariff
  Given company 7 has no tariff for service 'PROV' and the service tariff is 4.00
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 4.00
  And the separate charge flag is 'N'",
"Scenario: No tariff anywhere
  Given neither the company tariff table nor the service table has a tariff for service 'PROV'
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 0",
"Scenario Outline: Commission by channel and service
  Given a tariff of <tariff>, channel '<channel>' and service '<service>'
  When the commission is calculated
  Then the commission is <commission>

  Examples:
    | tariff | channel | service | commission |
    | 5.25 | WEB | PROV | 2.63 |
    | 5.25 | OFI | PROV | 5.25 |
    | 5.00 | OFI | NOMINA | 0 |
    | 5.00 | WEB | NOMINA | 0 |",
"Scenario: Commission included in the total
  Given an order value of 1000.00, a commission of 2.50 and separate flag 'N'
  When the total to debit is calculated
  Then the total is 1002.50",
"Scenario: Commission charged separately is excluded from the total
  Given an order value of 1000.00, a commission of 2.50 and separate flag 'S'
  When the total to debit is calculated
  Then the total is 1000.00"
],
"links": ["RULE-003", "RULE-004", "RULE-005"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Check that the account has enough funds",
"narrative": "As a company treasury operator, I want the payment to be rejected when the account cannot cover the total, so that accounts do not go beyond what is allowed.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Virtual account with exact balance
  Given a VIR account with balance 500.00 and a total to debit of 500.00
  When the funds check is performed
  Then the payment passes the check",
"Scenario: Virtual account short of funds
  Given a VIR account with balance 499.99 and a total to debit of 500.00
  When the funds check is performed
  Then the result is error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
"Scenario: Current account within the 100.00 overdraft
  Given a CTE account with balance 0.00 and a total to debit of 100.00
  When the funds check is performed
  Then the payment passes the check",
"Scenario: Current account beyond the 100.00 overdraft
  Given a CTE account with balance 0.00 and a total to debit of 100.01
  When the funds check is performed
  Then the result is error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
"Scenario: Account row not found
  Given no account row matches the account number and type
  When the funds check is performed
  Then the balance is null and neither insufficiency condition is true
  And the payment passes the check"
],
"links": ["RULE-006"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 3
},
{
"feature": "Pay an order from a company account",
"title": "Debit the account and mark the order as paid, all or nothing",
"narrative": "As a company treasury operator, I want the debit, the optional separate commission debit and the order update to succeed or fail together, so that accounts and orders are never left inconsistent.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Commission included in a single debit
  Given a total of 1002.50 and separate flag 'N'
  When the payment is processed
  Then one debit of 1002.50 with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' is made
  And no commission movement is made",
"Scenario: Commission charged as a second movement
  Given an order value of 1000.00, a commission of 2.50 and separate flag 'S'
  When the payment is processed
  Then a debit of 1000.00 with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' is made
  And a debit of 2.50 with reference 'COMISION PAGO' is made",
"Scenario: Separate flag with zero commission
  Given separate flag 'S' and a commission of 0 for service 'NOMINA'
  When the payment is processed
  Then no second movement is made",
"Scenario: First debit fails
  Given the debit of the total returns non-zero
  When the payment is processed
  Then the transaction is rolled back
  And the result is error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'",
"Scenario: Commission debit fails
  Given the first debit succeeded and the 'COMISION PAGO' debit returns non-zero
  When the payment is processed
  Then the transaction is rolled back including the first debit
  And the result is error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'",
"Scenario: Order marked as paid
  Given a pending order, successful debits and processing date 2024-05-31
  When the payment is processed
  Then the order state is 'A'
  And the payment date is 2024-05-31 and the commission charged is recorded
  And the transaction is committed with message 'PAGO REALIZADO'",
"Scenario: Order update touches no row
  Given the debits succeeded but the order row cannot be updated
  When the payment is processed
  Then the transaction is rolled back including the debits
  And the result is error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'"
],
"links": ["RULE-007", "RULE-008"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 5
}
]}
